metadata.title: PRIMA Controlled Public-Evidence Assessment
metadata.target_profile: AP-3 — implanted clinical therapeutic/assistive system with commercial transition
metadata.north_star: Connect ecosystem intelligence, exact-system assessment and governed refresh operations so that NeuroAI claims, risks, evidence gaps and institutional actions remain attributable, updateable and bounded.
metadata.boundary: No clinical advice, product certification, regulatory endorsement, independent screening substitute or deployment decision.

system.developer_owner: Science Corporation / La Science SAS; inherited from Pixium Vision
system.system_class: Implanted visual neuroprosthesis / retinal neural interface
system.function: External camera image capture and processing followed by near-infrared projection to a subretinal photovoltaic array that electrically stimulates remaining retinal cells.
system.intended_population_public_evidence: Adults at least 60 years old with bilateral geographic atrophy due to AMD, profound study-eye central vision loss and qualifying anatomy in the pivotal study; exact CE-authorized indication remains unresolved.
system.setting: Specialist ophthalmic surgery, structured rehabilitation, home daily use and optional remote rehabilitation in a historical configuration.
system.configuration_boundary: Trial configuration described in the NEJM publication plus historical public manual; exact 2026 CE-marked commercial models and software remain unresolved.
system.operational_independence: Participant-operated after training with external glasses, pocket processor, clinical follow-up, rehabilitation and maintenance dependencies. Not support-independent or self-contained.

risk_escalators: ESC-04 disability and vulnerable clinical context

components.name: Subretinal photovoltaic implant
components.identity: 2 mm × 2 mm, 30 μm crystalline-silicon array with 378 photovoltaic pixels, each 100 μm wide, as described in the primary study. Historical manual reference I009.

components.name: Frame-mounted camera and transparent glasses
components.identity: Camera captures the scene; glasses project processed 880 nm near-infrared patterns while permitting simultaneous natural peripheral vision. Historical references G001 and projection systems PS001/PS002.

components.name: Pocket processor
components.identity: Processes camera images and sends projection instructions to the glasses; historical manual lists 212 × 78 × 60 mm and 690 g with battery.

components.name: Embedded image-processing software
components.identity: Provides brightness, contrast, zoom and patient-specific optimization. Architecture, version, update lineage and machine-learning role are not publicly characterized for the CE-marked configuration.

components.name: Rehabilitation system and Bionic Vision Expert workflow
components.identity: Structured visual rehabilitation, including connection authorization and possible remote sessions in the historical PS002 configuration.

components.name: Implantation and ophthalmic follow-up pathway
components.identity: Subretinal implantation, perioperative management, OCT/fundus monitoring and management of procedure/device-related events.

components.name: Remote rehabilitation connectivity
components.identity: Historical PS002 configuration supports participant-authorized Wi-Fi connection to a rehabilitation system; current commercial availability and security architecture are unresolved.

roles: legal manufacturer stated on Science Pixium page

claims.claim: Science announced that PRIMA received a CE mark under the EU MDR from DEKRA and entered European commercial launch across 30 countries on 22 July 2026.
claims.strongest_supportable_claim: A company-announced CE-mark and commercial-launch state can be recorded for the stated European jurisdiction.
claims.prohibited_inference: Do not infer the exact certificate, current UDI/configuration, full authorized indication, reimbursement, activated sites, completed implantation or universal conformance.

claims.claim: The first commercial implantation was expected in Germany.
claims.strongest_supportable_claim: A first commercial implantation was publicly anticipated.
claims.prohibited_inference: Do not report a commercial implantation as completed without a dated primary source.

claims.claim: PRIMA received two HUD designations for a stated advanced-GA subset and Stargardt disease.
claims.strongest_supportable_claim: The announced designations permit a subsequent HDE marketing application.
claims.prohibited_inference: HUD designation is not HDE approval, US marketing authorization or an FDA effectiveness determination.

claims.claim: The PRIMAvera study implanted 38 participants and assessed 32 at month 12.
claims.strongest_supportable_claim: The 12-month complete-case denominator is 32, with six explicitly missing.
claims.prohibited_inference: Do not use 32 and 38 interchangeably or erase deaths, withdrawal and unavailable testing.

claims.claim: Twenty-six of 32 assessed participants met the prespecified ≥0.2 logMAR primary efficacy threshold at month 12.
claims.strongest_supportable_claim: 81% of 12-month completers met the threshold, 95% CI 64–93.
claims.prohibited_inference: Do not treat a single-group within-participant endpoint as randomized comparative effectiveness or population-wide effectiveness.

claims.claim: Multiple imputation estimated that 80% of all 38 implanted participants would meet the primary threshold.
claims.strongest_supportable_claim: The imputed full-cohort estimate is 80%, 95% CI 66–94.
claims.prohibited_inference: Do not collapse the imputed estimate into the observed 26/32 result.

claims.claim: Mean participant-choice visual-acuity improvement at month 12 was 0.51 logMAR, corresponding to 25.5 letters.
claims.strongest_supportable_claim: The mean improvement reflects the participant-choice condition and digitally enhanced prosthetic vision.
claims.prohibited_inference: Do not attribute the full gain to implant-native spatial resolution or to neural stimulation alone.

claims.claim: Twenty-seven of 32 participants reported reading letters, numbers or words at home with the device.
claims.strongest_supportable_claim: 84% of 12-month respondents self-reported home reading of these forms.
claims.prohibited_inference: Do not convert self-report into independently scored naturalistic accuracy, face recognition or broad environmental vision.

claims.claim: Twenty-six serious adverse events occurred in 19 participants through 12 months.
claims.strongest_supportable_claim: The published safety endpoint includes 26 procedure/device-related serious events in 19 of 38 implanted participants.
claims.prohibited_inference: Do not infer an absence of serious risk from event resolution, lack of device-alone attribution or mean vision preservation.

claims.claim: Mean natural peripheral visual acuity without PRIMA glasses was equivalent to baseline at month 12.
claims.strongest_supportable_claim: The group mean did not show a material change at the reported time point.
claims.prohibited_inference: Do not infer absence of individual harm, structural change, surgical burden or long-term risk.

claims.claim: The system combines a 378-pixel subretinal implant, camera glasses, 880 nm projection, pocket processing and clinical rehabilitation.
claims.strongest_supportable_claim: PRIMA is a multi-component implanted visual neuroprosthesis with substantial external hardware and care-pathway dependencies.
claims.prohibited_inference: Do not describe it as a self-contained implant, natural vision restoration, support-independent device or a cranial BCI.

claims.claim: Digital zoom, contrast, brightness and patient training materially contribute to measured and practical performance.
claims.strongest_supportable_claim: Reported performance belongs to the combined implant, processing, external hardware and trained-use system.
claims.prohibited_inference: Do not attribute digitally enhanced acuity to implant-native resolution alone.

claims.claim: The primary clinical evidence is an open-label, prospective, multicenter, single-group, baseline-controlled study designed by the sponsor with sponsor participation in analysis and writing.
claims.strongest_supportable_claim: The publication provides a serious multicenter prospective evaluation with explicit sponsor involvement and DSMB review.
claims.prohibited_inference: Do not describe the study as randomized, masked, independently sponsored or free of conflict-of-interest considerations.

claims.claim: The publicly retrievable patient manual is revision 2 from January 2022 and states clinical-investigation use.
claims.strongest_supportable_claim: The manual supplies historical operational evidence for PS001/PS002-era components.
claims.prohibited_inference: Do not treat it as the current CE-marked commercial IFU or proof that its service-life, security and labeling terms remain unchanged.

decisions.determination: Public evidence supports a bounded authorization- and configuration-specific claim that the PRIMA system can restore prosthetic central form vision in a selected adult population with bilateral geographic atrophy due to AMD under a surgically implanted, glasses-and-processor-dependent, digitally enhanced and rehabilitation-intensive care pathway.
conditions: Retain denominator, endpoint, component and regulatory-state boundaries.

decisions.determination: The public record does not establish complete CL-4 conformance because exact regulatory configuration, cybersecurity, data governance, postmarket vigilance, equity, remedy and lifecycle continuity remain unresolved.
conditions: No FAIL is assigned solely because evidence is unavailable.
Protected evidence may close conditions without requiring public disclosure of sensitive content.
decisions.expiry: Reassess on closure of P0 gaps.

decisions.determination: The observatory records a company-announced CE-mark and commercial-launch state in Europe. In the United States it records announced HUD designations only; no HDE approval or US marketing authorization is established.
conditions: Underlying CE certificate and current labeling remain required.
HUD and HDE states remain separate.
decisions.expiry: Reopen on primary certificate, HDE, labeling or jurisdictional change.

decisions.determination: The required dedicated assessment has been executed and the EU/US pathway distinction has been resolved. The certificate/configuration and first-commercial-implantation actions remain open.
conditions: No completed commercial implantation is recorded without confirmation.

prohibited_inferences: CE-mark announcement does not establish the exact certificate, UDI, current commercial configuration, labeling, reimbursement, site activation, completed implantation or complete conformance.
HUD designation does not establish HDE approval, US marketing authorization, reasonable assurance of effectiveness or any FDA finding for the full GA population.
An 81% complete-case response and an 80% imputed estimate are distinct results with distinct denominators.
A single-group baseline-controlled study does not establish randomized comparative effectiveness.
Prosthetic central form vision does not equal normal vision, natural central vision, color vision, face recognition or broad environmental vision.
Self-reported reading at home does not establish independently scored naturalistic accuracy or safe navigation.
Digitally enhanced acuity cannot be attributed to implant-native pixel resolution alone.
Mean preservation of natural peripheral visual acuity does not establish absence of individual ocular harm or long-term structural effect.
No event attributed to the device alone does not mean there was no device-related or procedure-related serious risk.
Resolution of many events does not erase incidence, severity, treatment burden or participant-level consequences.
Trial use with training and clinical support does not establish support-independent commercial use.
The January 2022 manual cannot be treated as the current CE-marked commercial IFU.
Commercial launch does not establish affordability, reimbursement, equitable access, production capacity or long-term support.
Publication of clinical evidence does not establish cybersecurity, update control, data governance or postmarket vigilance.
Sponsor participation in study design, analysis and writing does not invalidate the study, but it must remain visible in evidence appraisal.
No post-cutoff event identified in the controlled search does not prove global absence of unannounced, inaccessible or non-indexed events.
No demonstrated FAIL is inferred solely from unavailable public evidence.
The assessment does not provide clinical advice, product certification, regulatory endorsement or a deployment decision.
